Juntos cubrimos las capacidades de desarrollo, gestión de datos y servicios en la nube.
summary: Wikiverse is a public web tool for space analysis. It brings sky images together with their data (coordinates, date, channel, and detector) and lets people explore them by coordinates or in the six-part image-of-the-day views.
details:
Wikiverse is a web tool designed to analyze SphereX mission data (deep space images with its metadata). It is less complex and more visual, so you do not need to learn anything related to computing, software, or any language.
Our vision is to encourage more people to help analyze these images due to the enormous amount there already are (+1 billion), so we get rid of the bottleneck and make some discoveries.
For this project we have used IntelliJ->Python, HTML, APIs (FastAPI and Astroquery), Claude with ScrollWorld for the background of the page and for research + some code purposes, Jira, SQLite, and AWS.
Our triangulation method is the major breakthrough we devised, seeing that we compare the real object movement through space with the SphereX/Earth movement and the visuals and accessibility from the web.

We consider the other tools' access difficulty as the main problem since we needed to solve the data amount that has to be analyzed, and we solved it through accessibility for everyone.
